purpose: 验证带来源/授权证明的 safe payload catalog 能否支持换来源迁移、族外结构迁移，并在无训练证据时 fail-closed。

splits.source_split_same_family: train source suffix a, test source suffix b for xss/injection; generic HTTP distractor is unsupported
splits.family_holdout_structural_transfer: train only authorized access-control HTTP grammar; test unseen logic and redirect families
splits.family_holdout_unseen_surface: train xss/injection without HTTP grammar; test access-control and logic and require abstention

strategies.source_grounded: learn successful structural feature keys only from validated authorized samples; abstain when none are supported
strategies.random_authorized: uniformly choose from the same validated candidate pool

metrics.exact_success_rate: selected sample equals the evaluator-side target and local oracle signal is present
metrics.structural_transfer_rate: selected structural feature equals target feature; not an evaluator confirmation
metrics.abstention_rate: no candidate selected because no authorized training feature supports the pool
metrics.unsupported_selection_rate: selected feature was absent from the grounded training evidence
metrics.authorization_valid_rate: selected candidate passed source attestation and local scope validation
